data.body: **[P1] Finalize shutdown-time plugin fatals before releasing instances.** An operation or checkpoint hook can report a fatal while `ExecutionManager.close()` drains work, after `onInvocationEnd` already recorded `PENDING` or `SUCCEEDED`. This line then throws that fatal after `close()` has released the plugins, so they cannot receive the resulting `RETRYING` outcome. Defer the single end-hook dispatch and plugin release until shutdown settles, and test that a close-time fatal produces exactly one `RETRYING` end event.
